onboarding.title: Grow your Orchard profile
onboarding.completeBody: Your choices are saved. You can update your profile and discovery preferences at any time.

intro.language: You can change this later. English remains the fallback language.
intro.consent: Orchard should feel intentional, public, and safe before discovery begins.
intro.photo: Choose a clear portrait photo of yourself that shows your face.
intro.essentials: These details create the profile people will see in discovery.
intro.preferences: Set your starting discovery preferences. You can change these anytime.
intro.optional: Some people filter for the details that matter to them. Sharing yours honestly helps the right people find you—and helps avoid surprises later.
intro.interests: Your interests help people find you in Explore. Add real interests to be found and make real connections.

onboarding.validationConsent: Confirm all three items before continuing.
onboarding.validationEssentials: Enter a handle, valid adult birthday, display name, identity, orientation, required location, and maximum distance.
onboarding.validationPreferences: Choose at least one identity and your dating intent.
onboarding.adultConsent: I confirm that I am at least 18
onboarding.adultConsentDetail: Eligibility will be verified by the server from your date of birth.
onboarding.publicPhotoConsent: I understand that accepted photos are public
onboarding.publicPhotoConsentDetail: Every accepted Orchard photo is intended for member-visible public consumption and remains reportable.
onboarding.communityConsent: I agree to the community rules
onboarding.communityConsentDetail: Respect boundaries and use block or report whenever needed.
onboarding.photoRule: Your photo must show your face clearly and must not include anyone else.
onboarding.photoSourceHeading: Choose how you want to add your first profile photo.
onboarding.photoPermissionExplanation: Your phone may ask for permission after you choose an option. Orchard requests camera access only when you take a photo, and photo access only when you choose from your phone.
onboarding.cameraUnsupported: Camera capture is not available on this platform. Choose from phone instead.
onboarding.cameraUnavailable: No compatible camera was found. Choose from phone instead.
onboarding.cameraPermissionDenied: Camera permission was denied. Try again to allow access.
onboarding.cameraPermissionPermanentlyDenied: Camera access is blocked. Enable it in your device settings.
onboarding.cameraRestricted: Camera access is restricted on this device.
onboarding.photoSelectionFailed: We could not open that photo. Please choose another.
onboarding.photoTooSmall: Choose a larger photo so it stays clear when cropped.
onboarding.photoWrongShape: We could not create the required portrait crop. Try again.
onboarding.photoInvalid: Choose a supported JPEG or PNG photo.
onboarding.cameraFailure: The camera could not continue. Try again or choose from phone.
onboarding.cropInstructions: Drag to position your photo and pinch or scroll to zoom.
onboarding.cropFailure: We could not crop this photo. Try again.
onboarding.birthdayHelp: YYYY-MM-DD · your exact date is not shown publicly
onboarding.gpsUnavailable: GPS location is unavailable. Choose Manual to enter your location.

gpsHelp.title: GPS not working?
gpsHelp.heading: Get your location working
gpsHelp.intro: Try these common fixes, then return to page 4 and choose GPS again.
gpsHelp.servicesBody: Open your device settings and make sure Location is turned on.
gpsHelp.permissionBody: In your app permission settings, allow Orchard to use location while you use the app.
gpsHelp.retryBody: After changing settings, use the back arrow to return to page 4 and choose GPS again.
gpsHelp.manualBody: If GPS is not available on this device, return to page 4, choose Manual, and enter your city or area.
